humanRationale: an investigation plus a story that winds backward != multiple conflicting accounts != competing witness perspectives; the latter structure materially specifies how the mystery is told and therefore warrants a bounded MINOR revision.
materialIssues: curiosityHook: 'Everyone caught at Granny's cottage has an entirely different version of the incident' and 'Whose perspective actually explains' introduce a multiple-account/competing-perspective narrative mechanic that the authorized overview does not establish; an investigation told from the end backward does not itself imply conflicting versions of events.
whyWatch: 'conflicting witness stories' repeats and further concretizes the same unsupported testimony structure by asserting that the investigation is assembled from conflicting witness accounts.
